what: Rock-salt ionic solids of the LC20 set: reference lattice constants and the collaborator's cross-check values (xcsb.studies.ionic_lc)
status: NOT YET BANKED in the archive (refdata): transcribed from the user's message of 2026-11-13; to be banked write-once as a solids/ entry, then this file's 'archive_entry' fields name it
a_ref_source: LC20, ZPAE-corrected experiment; bn-r2SCAN paper SI Table S2, arXiv:2609.09034; same set as Hao et al. 2012; transcribed from the collaborator's LC20.json, branch strongxc-v3-solids commit 21f8d39
protocol_source: the collaborator's LC20 protocol (user 2026-11-13): ecutwfc = max(80 Ry, per-element floors), ecutrho = 8 ecutwfc, k-spacing 0.1 1/A (VASP convention, reference cell), conv_thr 1e-8 Ry, mixing_beta 0.3, n_occ + 4 bands, a = a_ref (1 + s), s = -3 % ... +3 % in 1 % steps, third-order Birch-Murnaghan

collaborator.note: the collaborator's own host, same pseudopotentials (SG15 ONCV 1.2) and protocol; a cross-check, not a reference
